name: Historical site modifiers
description: Descriptive historical variations compatible with specific location generators

fields.description: Access is concealed by terrain, a newer structure, or a maintained illusion.
Passages and usable spaces restrict movement, visibility, and bulky equipment.
The interior’s angles, distances, and connections cannot fit within its exterior, making maps locally accurate but globally contradictory.
Rooms, corridors, doors, or other internal spaces change position whenever nobody is directly observing them.
Signs, labels, directions, and room names are consistently and confidently wrong, even when replaced or corrected.
